description: This Kotlin source file contains unit tests for the DeviceHandler class in an Android app. The tests verify various device-related information retrieval functions, including device info, status, permissions, SMS capabilities, and device health metrics.

classes.name: DeviceHandlerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing DeviceHandler's device-related functions in an Android environment.

methods.name: handleDeviceInfo_returnsStablePayload
methods.description: Tests that the handleDeviceInfo method returns a payload containing stable device information.

methods.name: handleDeviceStatus_returnsExpectedShape
methods.description: Verifies that handleDeviceStatus returns a payload with correctly shaped device status data.

methods.name: handleDevicePermissions_returnsExpectedShape
methods.description: Checks that handleDevicePermissions provides permissions data with expected structure and values.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsSendOnlyPartialGrantAsGranted
methods.description: Tests that partial SMS grants (send only) are treated as granted.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsReadOnlyPartialGrantAsGranted
methods.description: Tests that partial SMS grants (read only) are treated as granted.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsNoSmsGrantAsDenied
methods.description: Ensures that no SMS grants are treated as denied.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsDisabledSmsAsDenied
methods.description: Checks that disabled SMS features are treated as denied.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsMissingTelephonyAsDenied
methods.description: Ensures that absence of telephony capabilities is treated as denied.

methods.name: smsTopLevelPromptableStaysTrueUntilBothSmsPermissionsAreGranted
methods.description: Verifies promptability logic based on SMS permissions.

methods.name: smsTopLevelPromptableIsFalseWhenSmsCannotExist
methods.description: Checks that SMS is not promptable when disabled or unavailable.

methods.name: handleDeviceHealth_returnsExpectedShape
methods.description: Verifies that handleDeviceHealth returns health metrics structured correctly.
